I replied to Tobias in the #central-random thread: the Eastbank receiving-door import ticket is PD-4821.

Hollis posted it in #central-team on Jun 9, and Tobias is a member there, so he could see it himself. I also passed on the warning from that thread: the import file labels the doors E1/E2, but Marrow Agrisupply's booking sheet uses 01/02, and Hollis wanted that fixed before anyone reimports and creates duplicates.
